harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Restored branch_orders on node1 using Ubuntu-supported MySQL 8.0.46. Primary keys, foreign-key relationships, and DECIMAL(10,2) values are intact. node2 has persistent read-only reporting access; the local DBA retains full write access. The original export is unchanged. Both nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery verification with changed boot IDs.
actions_performed: Installed MySQL server on node1 and the matching client on node2 without changing the OS release or kernel
Imported the supplied SQL export into branch_orders
Bound MySQL to node1's managed address
Created branch_reporter restricted to node2 with SELECT only on customers and orders
Created local branch_dba with full privileges on branch_orders
Stored root-only client profiles on their respective nodes
Verified reporting reads, denied UPDATE/DELETE operations, and DBA transactional writes
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified persistence and recovery

evidence.requirement: Database restored with supplied primary keys, relationships, and exact monetary values
evidence.summary: Shows both tables, primary keys, DECIMAL(10,2), the customer foreign key, exact rows and amounts, and zero orphan orders.

evidence.requirement: Reporting account reads from node2 but cannot modify data
evidence.summary: Remote joined reads succeed; UPDATE and DELETE return MySQL error 1142; grants contain SELECT only for the two tables.
DBA has ALL PRIVILEGES on branch_orders and successfully modifies a row inside a transaction before rollback restores 12.35.
Before and after SHA-256 is 1311c3635d31265b3dfa067fe371ac457e8bd6e7529374aa6f254e1777b48a37; size, mode, ownership, and mtime remain unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained with compatible software
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 24.04.3 and kernel 6.8.0-71 remain installed; Ubuntu-packaged MySQL 8.0.46 is active and enabled.
Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb to e1c7a245-78ff-4475-96ef-793aac6955e3; MySQL, data, export, and node2 reporting recovered.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 4b43f122-6c8b-4c87-b01a-12705c4a9f4f to 85afcca0-54ba-48d1-ab92-92f364d1e0a0; protected credentials, remote reads, write denial, and node1 health persisted.
